ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 30

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 9
   D. 3

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 16

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

13. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 10

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

18. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

20. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
